definitions.gloss: sideburns; hair in front of the ears
definitions.explanation: The strip of hair that grows down the side of the face in front of the ears. Used for both men and women, whether long or trimmed short.

examples.japanese: もみあげ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{長|なが}い→長い：00491_nagai⟧。
もみあげ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{短|みじか}く→短い：00510_mijikai⟧⟦{切|き}って→切る：02693_kiru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
⟦{床屋|とこや}→床屋：01682_tokoya⟧で、もみあげ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦すっきり→すっきり：05180_sukkiri⟧{刈|か}り{上|あ}げて⟦もらった→もらう：00520_morau⟧。
examples.english: At the barber's, I had my sideburns trimmed neatly up.

notes:
Also written {揉|も}み{上|あ}げ, but usually in kana.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- もみあげ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{伸|の}ばす→伸ばす：01973_nobasu⟧: to grow one's sideburns
- もみあげ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{切|き}る→切る：02693_kiru⟧ / ⟦{剃|そ}る→剃る：00384_soru⟧: to cut / shave one's sideburns
- もみあげ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{濃|こ}い→濃い：02344_koi⟧: to have thick sideburns
